skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply basic security management techniques used in databases including access control, user management, and access rights management.
Analyze application security issues and methods of accessing and manipulating databases from applications.
Develop security policies, continuous monitoring practices, and maintain proactive security postures.
Manage database systems to protect data integrity and prevent data leakage, spoofing, and destruction.
Monitor and respond to security incidents, including active monitoring and risk assessment.
Implement security measures such as encryption, backups, and recovery procedures.
Perform security testing on source code and evaluate internal software development processes.
Ensure physical security of databases and applications.
